paragraphs.text: Sphinx is a creature type used on Magic cards that depict a species of large and powerful creatures with lion -like bodies, human faces, and feathered wings.

Sphinxes tend to be a long-lived species. Sphinxes (or sphinges) are known for their vast intellect and cunning, and often never speak, save for riddles. Some sphinxes can apparently tell truth from lies and separate truth from honesty, as demonstrated by Sharuum . Some rival dragons in size and strength.
Notably, Sphinxes are the iconic species for the color blue , though some are also aligned with white and/or black mana. Sphinxes are least common in red and green .

The first card to bear the creature type was Petra Sphinx in Legends . The first sphinxes printed in blue were Belltower Sphinx and Cerulean Sphinx in Ravnica: City of Guilds , the second and third ever sphinxes.

Sphinx would later become the iconic species for the color blue. Compared to the other iconic species, Sphinx was the last introduced and tied with hydra for the last to have a creature printed in its emblematic color. This lateness is a factor as to the color consistency of Sphinxes, as only seven sphinxes are nonblue in color identity, four of which were printed in the color-bending set Reality Fracture .
Many Sphinxes within the Multiverse were likely influenced by Azor , an ancient Sphinx planeswalker who once traveled between the worlds to bring order.

Between the Sundering and the Conflux of Alara , Sphinxes were found exclusively on Esper . Sphinxes on Esper are highly revered and respected as leaders of their communities because of their vast knowledge. Sphinxes prefer to remain a mystery to the humanoids, making their homes on distant, remote islands shrouded from view by magic. Their visits with humanoids are reasonably frequent, but sphinxes do not form lasting relationships. All sphinxes are vastly knowledgeable and insightful, but beyond that, their characters vary widely, from cold and calculating to honorable and beneficent.

The Sphinx Crucius is said to have created the Etherium alloy, which shaped Esper into what it is today. After Crucius's disappearance, no new etherium could be synthesized, but Sharuum showed Esper residents how to thin the alloy, making it last longer.
The Leviathans and Krakens that lurk in Esper's seas have been documented to predate even the shard's oldest sphinxes.

Amonkhet sphinxes have leonine bodies, hawklike wings, and faces resembling humans, framed by great frills or manes of feathers. Their powerful forearms are also feathered, and fans of long feathers form their tails. They were perhaps the only creatures to remain uncorrupted by the influence of Nicol Bolas . Their impenetrable minds proved to be even beyond Bolas's mind control ability; for this reason, he placed them under a curse, banning them from communicating with other creatures in any way. Most citizens of Naktamun believed that the Sphinxes had taken vows of silence until the God-Pharaoh had returned to them. They began to speak only after the Second Sun aligned. They whispered dire warnings, though no one listened.

A few rare sphinxes have the heads of rams instead of the humanlike faces of other sphinxes. Though they lie under the same curse as other sphinxes, they are less enigmatic and more aggressive, actively attacking angels , demons , and other agents of Nicol Bolas they encounter in the desert. They stay far from Naktamun and care little for its people; their hatred of Bolas is driven by his curse.

The Theorist 's efforts to minimize discordance in the Echoverse influenced the mana alignment of his version of Arcavios . Instead of snarls of conflicting sources, harmonious mana merged, creating five elder sphinxes who later became known as the Founder Sphinxes of Hexhaven .

The Theorist's complex relationship with sphinxes undoubtedly influenced the shape of the Founder Sphixes. Official histories of Hexhaven assert that the elder sphinxes took pity on the denizens of Arcavios and offered them protection from the elements. What the residents of Echoverse Arcavios perceived as storms and seismic activity were actually the residual effects of our reality magic as the plane and its collective history took shape all at once.

The sphinxes began teaching some of these people the magic they innately commanded. A community of students grew, and the sphinxes formally founded an institution where they oversaw the training of Arcavios's population to ensure their survival. Hexhaven has five schools dedicated to different disciplines of magical training based on the magic mastered by each of the Founder Sphinxes. Since the founding of Hexhaven, the sphinxes have become aloof, mercurial, and puzzling. They may have once taken pity on the peoples of Arcavios, but now they are indifferent, more interested in their legacies, as represented by the parade of elite battlemages that graduate from their schools.

As the deans of each school, the sphinxes hold audiences to hear updates and concerns from professors and elite cadets. However, most of the day-to-day operations are left to the professors, provost, and the campus headmaster.

The sphinxes of Old Capenna acted as renowned fortune tellers, who often fought shadow conflicts to ensure their conflicting prophecies came to pass. Of this older generation of sphinx, only the Obscura boss Raffine still lives. Though not extinct, sphinxes are still extremely rare and solitary creatures.
Sphinxes roamed the cold wastes of Dominaria 's Ice Age .

There used to be a small number of sphinxes on Mirrodin . They were so rare that most believed them to disappear into the aether when seen. It is known that at least the Consecrated Sphinx was compleated by the Phyrexians and to fight a Steel Hellkite .

Sphinxes of Ravnica are typically affiliated with the Azorius . They are solitary creatures that value their privacy but are also willing to share their insights in times of need. In fact, the sphinx planeswalker Azor was the main author of the legal system of the plane, creating the Guildpact and guild system. Azor himself was the founder and parun of the Azorius, but he left Ravnica after some time to bring order and guidance to other planes of the Multiverse.

Another notable sphinx on the plane was Isperia , guildmaster of the Azorius during the events of Guilds of Ravnica . She was petrified and killed by Vraska , leader of the Golgari Swarm , under Bolas' orders.
A few Sphinxes are aligned with House Dimir and also count as nightmares .
In an alternate reality, sphinxes populated the planeswalker Serra 's realm instead of angels.

Theran sphinxes are primordial, mysterious beings with ancient knowledge. They have abstract thought patterns, so even when they are not trying to be enigmatic, they still are. One, Medomai , is a prophet at Meletis , going into the city several times to warn of future events.

On Zendikar , sphinxes are to be found in Sejiri , on the Jwar Isle , and most recently in Magosi and Tazeem as well. Most Sphinxes search remote locations to ponder Zendikar's mysteries and contemplate what they have learned. They jealously protect their lairs from other sphinxes and large predators, such as dragons , but they pay little attention to smaller visitors. A sphinx's lair is often difficult to reach and typically involves treacherous climbing for creatures without the ability to fly. A visitor who can reach the spot is often rewarded with an audience—but those who come in search of answers are likely to leave disappointed.
